story_title: Lina and Adams the Little Helpers
title: Lina and Adams the Little Helpers 🧹 | Helping at Home Words in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Mama has a busy day, so Lina and Adams become little helpers! They sweep, wash the dishes and fold the laundry — and Milo the cat helps too, in his own funny way. 🧹🍽️🧺
In this English story for kids, children learn 8 new words: chores, broom, sweep, dishes, dry, laundry, basket and fold. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
🏠 chores — أشغال الدار — les tâches ménagères
🧹 broom — مكنسة / شطابة — le balai
✨ sweep — يكنس / شطّب — balayer
🍽️ dishes — الأواني / الماعن — la vaisselle
🌬️ dry — ناشف / يجفف — sec / sécher
👕 laundry — الصابون / الغسيل — le linge
🧺 basket — سلة / قفة — le panier
🧦 fold — يطوي — plier

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: give your child a small, safe job at home — folding small clothes or drying plastic cups — and name it in English: "Let's fold!" Pause after each new word and say it out loud. Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

lines.text: It is Saturday morning. The sun comes in through the kitchen window.
Mama is very busy today. She has many things to do.
Adams, Mama looks a little tired.
Let's help her! We can be little helpers!
Yes! Little helpers, here we come!
Milo the cat stretches and yawns. Meow! He wants to help too.
Let's see what they do!
Mama, can we help you with the chores?
We want to do jobs in the house, like big kids!
Mama smiles a big smile. Thank you, my darlings!
Chores are the little jobs we do to take care of our home.
Say it with me: chores!
We can do the chores together. Teamwork!
There are crumbs on the kitchen floor from breakfast.
I will get the broom! It is next to the door.
The broom has a long handle and soft brushy bristles.
A broom is a brush with a long handle for cleaning the floor.
Can you say it? Broom!
Milo looks at the broom. What is that big brush? Meow?
Adams moves the broom from side to side. Swish, swish, swish!
Look, Lina! I sweep the crumbs into a little pile.
Good job! You sweep so well!
When we sweep, we move dirt across the floor with a broom.
Say it with me: sweep!
Milo chases the broom. Swish! Pounce! Lina and Adams laugh.
Next, they look at the table. There are bowls and cups from breakfast.
Now let's help Mama with the dishes.
Mama washes the dishes in warm, soapy water. Bubbles, bubbles!
Dishes are the plates, bowls and cups we eat and drink from.
Can you say it? Dishes!
Mama, I can carry the plastic cups. They will not break!
Lina takes a soft towel. Rub, rub, rub.
I will dry the cups. No more water!
This cup is dry now. I will put it away.
Dry means there is no water on it.
Say it with me: dry!
Mama gives them a big thumbs up. Super helpers!
Now they go to the bedroom. There is a big pile of clean clothes.
Wow! So many shirts and socks!
This is the laundry. Mama washed it this morning.
Laundry is the clothes that are washed, or need washing.
Can you say it? Laundry!
The clean laundry smells so fresh. Mmm, like flowers!
Adams finds something big and round next to the bed.
Here is the basket for the clothes!
But wait! Something is inside the basket. It is moving!
Peek-a-boo! It is Milo! He is sleeping in the basket. Meow!
A basket is a box we use to carry and keep things.
Say it with me: basket!
Lina picks up a shirt. She makes it small and neat.
First, the arms go in. Then, fold it in half!
I can fold the small socks and the towels!
When we fold, we bend clothes over to make them small and neat.
Can you say it? Fold!
One, two, three. Soon there is a neat pile of folded clothes.
But oh no! Milo jumps on the pile. Boing!
The folded clothes fall down everywhere.
Oh, Milo! Now we must fold them again.
That's okay, Adams. Milo is only playing.
We can fold them again, together. It will be quick!
And they do. Fold, fold, fold. All done!
Milo sits nicely in the basket now. Sorry! Meow.
In the evening, Mama comes to see the house.
The floor is clean. The dishes are dry. The laundry is folded.
Surprise, Mama! We did the chores!
We are your little helpers!
Mama gives them a big hug. Thank you! I love you so much.
Now Mama has time to play. They play ball in the garden at sunset.
Helping makes everyone happy!
At night, Lina and Adams are ready for bed.
Today I used the broom to sweep the floor.
And I helped dry the dishes and fold the laundry.
And Milo slept in the basket!
Milo is already asleep. Purr, purr.
Good night, little helpers.
Good night, everyone!
